message: Named Revenue, formatted as dollars, but counts rows.
AVERAGEX iterates order lines, so each order is weighted by its line count; this is not average per order.
fix: measure 'Avg Order Value' = DIVIDE([Total Sales], DISTINCTCOUNT(Sales[OrderID]))

message: The SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR calculation is repeated three times with no VAR.
fix:
VAR _py = CALCULATE([Total Sales], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Date'[Date]))
RETURN DIVIDE([Total Sales] - _py, _py)

message: Sales is computed by two formulas: SUM of a calculated column here, SUMX in Total Sales. They agree today only by luck of the shared formula.
fix: Delete Sales Amount and use [Total Sales] everywhere, or define it as = [Total Sales].

message: Budget is many-to-many on Product[Category] only, so it cannot be sliced by Date, Store or Customer. [Budget vs Actual] subtracts a budget with no date filter from sales that have one.
fix: Add a Category dim and a Date (month) key to FactBudget and relate both as many-to-one.

message: Bi-directional filter with no BidiReason annotation (per team rule CUS007). It also lets the store RLS filter shrink the Customer list.
fix: Remove the line, or add: annotation BidiReason = <why>

message: RLS hard-codes one e-mail (per team rule CUS009). Every joiner/leaver needs a model change, and the role grants nothing to anyone else.
fix: tablePermission Security = [UserPrincipalName] = USERPRINCIPALNAME()   // hidden Security table (UserPrincipalName, StoreKey) related to dim_store[StoreKey]

message: The only filter is on dim_store. It reaches Sales, but FactBudget (related only to Product) stays fully visible, and Customer Email/Phone are exposed for customers reachable through the bi-directional link.
fix: Filter FactBudget through a store/region key as well, and hide or restrict Customer[Email] and Customer[Phone] (object-level security).
